contentText:
Hey there, buddy.

I never liked hunting for Golden Skulltulas in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . The game has 100 of them tucked all over Hyrule, and even over my many hours with the N64 classic growing up, I can't remember ever actually finding all of them, or even wanting to. Jumping into the Ocarina of Time remake , I expected to ignore the Golden Skulltulas once again. But while poking around Nintendo's Zelda Notes companion app, I discovered that its maps are a huge help to tracking down all of the elusive golden spiders - and pretty much every other collectible in the game - and now I find myself constantly opening up the app to make sure I haven't …

Read the full story at The Verge.
